record.question:
##Question##
Use the 'ggplot2' and 'ggrepel' packages to draw a volcano plot to visualize the differential miRNA expression between patient groups labeled as 1 and 3. Use the data frame (named as variable 'DEGAll') that includes columns for log2 fold change ('logFC'), p-value ('PValue'), and color. Highlight up-regulated miRNAs in red and down-regulated miRNAs in blue. Mark the top 10 significant miRNAs (stored in 'top_miRNAs') with their names on the plot.

##Task##
1. Creates a dataframe named 'DEGAll" by adding log2 fold changes, p-values, and colors for significant miRNAs.
2. Selects the top 10 miRNAs by p-value and log2 fold change.
3. miRNArates a volcano plot and labels the top miRNAs.
record.answer:
{"reference_answer": "library(dplyr)
# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# Create a data frame with the necessary columns for the volcano plot
DEGAll <- results %>%
  mutate(
    logFC = log2FoldChange,
    PValue = pValue,
    color = ifelse(pValue < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 0.5,
                   ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0.5, "red", "blue"), "gray")
  )

# Define colors
color <- c(red = "#800000", gray = "#A9A9A9", blue = "#4682B433")

# Define the number of top miRNAs to label
top_n <- 10

# Filter top miRNAs by p-value and log2 fold change
top_miRNAs <- DEGAll %>%
  arrange(pValue) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n)

# Plot the volcano plot
ggplot(DEGAll, aes(logFC, -log10(PValue), col = color)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_miRNAs,
    aes(label = miRNA),
    size = 3,
    box.padding = 0.3,
    point.padding = 0.5,
    segment.color = 'grey50',
    color = 'black'  # Set miRNA label color to black
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = color) +
  labs(x = "log2 (fold change)", y = "-log10 (q-value)") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), lty = 4, col = "darkgreen", lwd = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.5, 0.5), lty = 4, col = "darkgreen", lwd = 0.6) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14)
  )", "test_cases": "ncol(DEGAll) == 8"}
